title: Let a complete task-sync import take another host's removal of a task this host published since its last import
outcome: Let a complete task-sync import take another host's removal of a task this host published since its last import
acceptance: A complete import (rewritten head after a rebuild, explicit --basis or --rebuild) treats a local task missing from the folder as published, and so as another host's removal, exactly when a commit since the last import held its file, including merges decided against either parent, a merge not yet committed, a head recorded without a source, and incremental exports since that import; a task no commit ever held stays this host's own and owed to the next export
A removal it cannot read with certainty, such as one behind a shallow boundary, refuses by name with the fetch that restores the history instead of republishing the task
A refused (execution_history) removal joins the baseline with the local document and stays held; an admitted one retires; tests cover each case above
